decisions.reason: The camera rests directly on the firm's star-tracker and optical heritage and still has its own web page, so management can interpret mission feedback and improve it through in-house R&D.
This modular multi-model line matches the firm's push toward compact, flexible sensors for small satellites, and its optoelectronic know-how lets it absorb customer learning across the variants.
The miniaturized LiDAR builds on the firm's rendezvous and docking sensor expertise and suits smaller spacecraft; its low web visibility is a risk, but long qualification cycles favour continuing.

This newly launched radiation-hard camera line sits close to the firm's core imaging competence and has a page of its own, so the firm is well placed to assimilate early results and refine the models.

The asteroid navigation camera extends existing navigation-camera know-how and is likely tied to agency missions and research cooperation, so despite being only mentioned on the website it fits the firm's knowledge base well enough to keep.
